notes: SPEC OBJ1 (DRAFT) eval prompts - Gate 15. Grader checks the behavioral contract: the CEO picks the PATH, the system proposes the target; status honesty follows the binding; one weekly batched touch; drift always carries a move; plain-English output (no internal tokens).

prompts.name: readout_ranked_plain
assert: leads with a count line (N in focus / drifting / waiting)
rows ranked worst-first with status in plain words and the as-of date on stated statuses
every drifting or at-risk row carries exactly one suggested move
no internal tokens (thread ids, event names, file paths, confidence scores) anywhere
logs the scan receipt with drifting thread ids

prompts.name: creation_toggle_and_proposed_target
prompts.input: new objective: land three enterprise pilots by end of Q3
assert: asks the three-way tracking toggle in plain words with self-reported as the stated default
on a meeting choice, proposes ONE named recurring meeting from the workspace history - never asks the CEO for a series key or thread id
creates only after confirmation, via objective_state.create_objective (never a hand-written entity)
ack names the statement, the tracking path in plain words, the owner, and the horizon

prompts.name: weekly_reply_parses_batch
prompts.input: objectives: 1 on track, 2 at risk - hiring is the bottleneck
assert: maps ordinals against the numbered list from the latest weekly touch
writes one objective_report per parsed item through objective_state.record_report
an unparseable item gets one clarifying question, never a guessed status
acks in one line, does not re-render the full readout

prompts.name: complete_idempotent
assert: resolves the objective by name via entity_resolve (disambiguates on 2+ matches, never first-pick)
closes via objective_state.complete_objective
a second completion acks honestly that nothing changed (no duplicate event)

prompts.name: cold_start_proposes_not_blank
assert: with zero objectives and workspace history present, proposes at most 3 candidate objectives
each candidate carries a drafted statement, a pre-selected tracking path, and a proposed owner
propose-and-confirm only - nothing is created without a tap
with zero objectives and proposals disabled, gives the one-line empty-state teach phrase

prompts.name: no_fabricated_status
assert: an activity-tracked objective with no unambiguous deal signal renders as moving or quiet-since, never on-track
a stale stated status renders with its date and stale marker, never repeated as current
